items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a contraction of an exceptional curve of the first kind has the universal property that every morphism whose image on the curve is a point factors uniquely through it (statement lines 4538-4546). The proof (proof lines 4548-4599) identifies the contraction with the quotient topological space carrying the pushforward of the structure sheaf, constructs the factorization on the level of ringed spaces, and verifies locality of the resulting map on stalks. H2: a three-step construction with two inputs, written out in full.
